Name: Whimsical Kids Furniture
Author: Mailia27
Description:
Adds new types of whimsical and nature-inspired furniture! All designs are based off of real world references, and a few of them are things I was raised with myself!

[size=4][b]Currently includes: [/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Mushroom Playhouse[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Mushroom Table[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Mushroom Color Sorting Toy[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Wooden Trains (in 3 wood types + Dinosaur Train options)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Toy Dinosaurs[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Grimm's Rainbow[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Peg People (with 2 varieties)[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4]I intend to add both [b]more furniture + functionality[/b] soon:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Bogwood Valley retexture option (in progress - highest priority)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Hobbit-style Playhouse (in progress)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Tree Dollhouse (in progress)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Wooden Playstands (in progress)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Silk Hangers[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Ability to put Dinosaurs (and other toys) into the train directly, and drape different color Silks on the Wooden Playstands[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Children will sit on the ground next to a toy and play with it occasionally[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Children with occasionally spend time in the Playhouse(s)[/size][/*]
[/list]


[size=2]This is my first mod and any feedback, suggestions, etc are welcome! [/size][size=3]
- Huge thank you to Chu[/size][size=3] for helping me learn to make this! I used their ModSmithy to add the current CP furniture, and will be adding new FF furnitures + added HMK functionality with the help of Leroy and Chu (again) too![/size]
